quest.title: Chain of Interests
quest.description: You repelled the chasing mercenaries and now it is time to leave for the desert.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x600, Mora x35475, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Go to the desert auction site
Go to the desert auction site

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... hot... If only there was some shade for us to cool off under...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe we should take a break.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: We still have a long way to go, so you'll need to hang in there for a while longer. This is not a good place to rest, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *pant* Okay... But don't you feel hot too, Cyno?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Of course, but I'm accustomed to these conditions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Care to share any tips? Paimon's about to melt away...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Just try to stay focused — use your willpower to support your mind. The moment you start to give in is when you'll feel more tired.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Take one step after another. Don't let your mind perceive your body's limitations. We must get somewhere safe before we can relax.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh okay, if you say so. But where would be a more safe place to rest? Paimon thinks this is a perfectly safe place to stop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just look around, it's just sand and desert. There aren't any monsters for miles around... Whoa! Where did these scorpions come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Watch out, something's not right about them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Well, Paimon really didn't expect to see those here.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Those weren't just normal scorpions.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: See, there are marked numbers on their pincers. They were raised by someone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Someone doesn't want us to show up at the auction. These scorpions were sent to keep us away.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: We are surrounded by desert as far as the eye can see. If we were killed out here, nobody would ever know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is super dangerous! Good thing we didn't let our guard down.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Something's not right... There are no roads in the desert, so how could they know where we are?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: #Stay still, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Here's the answer... They must have planted this on you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: A miniature tracking device made by the Kshahrewar. They can use this to discern your approximate location.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: But this device wasn't licensed for mass production. Where did they get it... Could someone from the Kshahrewar also be involved? Hmm, but that doesn't seem right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, Paimon never knew that kind of thing even existed! Why would it be on {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: They probably planted it on the Traveler during our fight with the mercenaries earlier.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: It was a frantic fight. It's only natural you didn't notice the device.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, good thing you were able to find it, Cyno! Now let's get rid of it!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmm, no... Hold on to it for now. It might still be useful for us.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Let's keep heading to the auction. It would be dangerous to linger here any longer.

talks.objective: Continue heading to the desert auction

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weird... Is this where the auction is?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's nobody here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, not a single soul... Maybe they're on break right now or something?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: We didn't waste any time getting here after we defeated those mercenaries. They shouldn't have been able to give any warning of our arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: But even so, they still knew we were coming. Someone here must have been watching the tracker, and warned everyone to clear out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, what should we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: We search the area. They couldn't have moved all the Knowledge Capsules so quickly. There might still be something left for us to find.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's take a good look around the area!

talks.objective: Continue heading to the desert auction

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (The scattered footprints have not been completely buried by the wind and sand, but it is impossible to speculate on the direction of the merchants' escape from the footprints.)

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (The Sumpter Beast is drinking water leisurely and seems to be completely unaffected.)

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (Ordinary Canned Knowledge, seems to have nothing to do with the Court of Desolation.)

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (A large amount of Canned Knowledge has been piled here, enough to fetch an extremely large amount of Mora at market price.)

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, nothing in particular...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Only some average-looking Knowledge Capsules.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: It's possible there weren't many Knowledge Capsules containing info about the Court of Desolation, so they carried those off.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: #But don't worry, I have another idea. {NICKNAME}, you two start heading back the way we came. I will remain hidden here.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Come back and meet me here after some time has passed. I'm sure something will come up by then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that's why you wanted me to carry the tracking device...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: They packed up in a hurry and didn't have time to carry off all their goods. They won't just leave them here.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Once they think we've left the premises, they'll be back to pick up their belongings. We just need to make sure the tracker goes far enough from here to make them assume that it's safe to come back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! We'll lure them out because they'll think we've left!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, we'll start heading away and leave this place to you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Yes, and don't worry, if they dare to return, I'll make sure they stay.

talks.objective: Leave the auction with the tracker

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... So tired... We've probably gone far enough now, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Let's rest for a little while before we go back to find Cyno!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You sit and rest for a while nearby.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, it's probably about time for us to head back to the auction.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go, maybe Cyno's finally found some leads.

choices.text: We should go a little further.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Further? But Paimon can't go another step... How about we rest here for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Looks like Cyno caught someone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're the bad guy behind all this, aren't ya? Alright, tell Paimon everything you know!

choices.text: Does he know anything about the smuggling?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I didn't act immediately when he showed up. Rather, I laid low and observed for a while instead.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: He is not the primary instigator, but he is most likely one of the more important dealers here. Am I right?

response.speaker: Bahari
response.text: Yes, impressive... You certainly live up to your reputation, Cyno. If I had any idea you were still around, I wouldn't have gotten so greedy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Greedy? What do you mean by that?

response.speaker: Bahari
response.text: Once everyone knew you were coming, all the Canned Knowledge dealers abandoned their goods and fled at once. Obviously, there wasn't time to pack up everything.

response.speaker: Bahari
response.text: Since all the goods were just left here unsupervised, I thought I'd use the opportunity to come back and take what I could. You know, free merchandise is good business, but... *sigh* I suppose there's no use explaining it now.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: You must know who's manufacturing and selling the Canned Knowledge, correct? Will you tell us willingly, or do I need to make you talk?

response.speaker: Bahari
response.text: No, no, I'll talk. But before that, perhaps we can take the conversation elsewhere?

response.speaker: Bahari
response.text: If we stay here, chances are that someone will see me with you. That would put both me and my family in danger.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Alright. Where do you suggest we go?

response.speaker: Bahari
response.text: How about my home in Aaru Village? It should be safe there.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: #Fine, let's head out. You can throw away the tracker now, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Does he have an important role in the auction?

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: Dad, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: Oh, we have guests? Uh, hi there...

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: This is my daughter, Simin. She can be a little shy of strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Why don't you run along now, dear? Dad needs to talk with our guests.

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: Oh... okay.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Everyone knows Cyno in our business, but let me ask, who are you two?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: To be honest, I really didn't expect to see Cyno the lone operator working with any partners. When I saw the tracker start moving away, I assumed you had decided to just go back empty-handed.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: But even though you caught me, I'd still urge you to stop while you still can. You should abandon this investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Everything from the manufacturing of Canned Knowledge, to the sales and even splitting the profits... every step of the process involves dozens, if not hundreds of people. Massive profits have brought everyone together in this business.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Everyone will try their best to defend this industry that we've worked to build. It will be a long and difficult fight, even for you, Cyno.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: And even if you manage to win in the end, no one will thank you. If anything, you yourself might even feel remorse... Why are you so bent on putting us out of business?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Everyone has their own reasons for what they do. I don't have to explain mine.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: Here's some tea, Dad... and for the guests, too.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Ah, right. I forgot to offer tea to our guests. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: Don't mention it... And, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: I should tell you that our tea tastes kinda bitter, but I put some sugar in to make it a little tastier.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: That's my girl. Do we still have any sugar left? If not, I'll buy some more next time.

dialogues.speaker: Simin
dialogues.text: Yes, we do... Okay, I'm gonna go have a rest now.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Didn't you say that everyone's in it for the massive profits? That sure doesn't seem to be the case for you.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Ahem, actually that's what I wanted to talk to you about. I was hoping to ask you for a favor.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: My daughter was born with a chronic disease, so she has a relatively weak heart and lungs. Even slightly strenuous exercise can cause her to faint and prove to be a life-threatening risk.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: That's why she's never really had any friends to play with, and why she locks herself up in her room most of the time. She has to take lots of medicine, and it doesn't come cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: As for me, I was just an average merchant. I would wake up early and travel all around to make a profit, but the Mora was still nowhere near enough. I could only watch my daughter's health deteriorate day by day.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: Until one day, someone reached out and showed me a way to really make a profit...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Selling Canned Knowledge?

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: That's right. With all the Mora I made, I could finally afford medical treatment for my daughter. Nothing made me happier than seeing her get better.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: There are many others like me. Smuggling Canned Knowledge might seem like an unforgivable crime to you, but to us, it's a means of survival.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: I wanted to tell you all this so that maybe you could understand and change your mind. Please stay out of this, Cyno. Give us a way to survive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... That means that if we prevent the sale of Canned Knowledge, his daughter will...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I must get to the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I can find someone to help treat your child, but I cannot turn a blind eye to the smuggling. These are two completely different issues.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: *sigh* I somehow knew you would say that, but having your word to help my daughter is enough for me. Since you insist on continuing the investigation, you should have a look around the back of my home.

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: You'll find some goods I received just recently. I think everything will become clear to you once you see them.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You go to the back of the house with Cyno.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Look at all of this!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Yes, all neatly packed away and organized in boxes. To think that this is only one dealer's worth...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Small producers couldn't possibly support such a large quantity of goods. Hmm, could the Akademiya have a hand in this? But such a volume of goods wouldn't be able to slip through inspection...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! These seem different from the other Knowledge Capsules we've seen. Maybe they contain knowledge about the Court of Desolation?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Yes, that would make sense. Wait, what's this...?

choices.text: Some sort of marking we've never seen before.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Yes, it's a matra seal, indicating that the goods have passed matra inspection.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I started to suspect that someone in the Akademiya might be involved when I found the tracker earlier, but how they could ship so much Canned Knowledge out of the Akademiya was still a mystery.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: The pieces have now all fallen into place. With this matra seal, goods can leave the Akademiya without undergoing a second inspection.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmph, no wonder they don't want me to investigate. It turns out that a matra is behind this. Even I find it hard to believe.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It could be a misunderstanding.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: #Could I ask you for a favor, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Since all this Canned Knowledge came from the Akademiya, then it's highly likely that the knowledge regarding the Court of Desolation originated from research files stored within the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: If we can enter the repository, we can find out who accessed these files.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: But considering my current status, if I suddenly show up at the Akademiya now, it will only draw unnecessary attention.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: You'll need to be the one who checks the records. I'll write a letter to Nabil and he'll take you there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure thing, leave it to us!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I'll also keep working here in the meantime. Although our leads all are currently pointing to someone within the Akademiya, it's obvious that they also have power outside of it.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: We can get more information on other dealers from Bahari. I'll stay here and make some preparations. You can come find me anytime if you uncover more info.

choices.text: Do you know what it is, Cyno?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: There's no time to lose. Leave as soon as you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Listen buddy, you'd better not try to trick us!

dialogues.speaker: Bahari
dialogues.text: C'mon now, do you really think I'd try to pull anything under Cyno's watch? Seriously, what can I even do?
